en: Waaagh temporarily boosts the speed, damage and defense of nearby Ork infantry. The more units using this ability together, the greater the effect.
zh_new: WAAAGH 會暫時提升附近獸人步兵的速度、傷害和防禦。一起使用此能力的單位越多，效果越強。

en: To zoom the camera in or out, scroll up or down with the mouse wheel. Scrolling up zooms in and scrolling down zooms out. Press the keyboard's Backspace key to reset the camera to defaults.
zh_new: 若要拉近或拉遠鏡頭，請上下滾動滑鼠滾輪。向上滾動會拉近，向下滾動會拉遠。按下鍵盤的 Backspace 鍵可將鏡頭重設為預設狀態。
